text:
elena: Quick heads-up everyone — launching the Community Templates v0.3.1 patch and announcing a small community event: Template Triage Night. Patch fixes a CI flake and adds CONTRIBUTING clarifications. Details: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-templates/releases/tag/v0.3.1 :sparkles:

sam: Nice. Triage night — is that live or virtual?

elena: Virtual, Wednesday 7pm PT. We9ll run 90 minutes: quick demo of the new eval-harness example, then pairing rooms to triage open template issues and mentor new contributors.

jordan: I can host a room for Windows dev setups and onboarding.

maya: I9ll do a short walkthrough of the CONTRIBUTING checklist and how to write a minimal CI test.

elena: Thanks! We9re also piloting a tiny contributor stipend program: $100 gift cards for first-time contributors who land their first PR during triage night. Objective is to lower the barrier and reward momentum. Rules in the release notes.

sam: Do we need to sign anything to accept the stipend?
elena: Standard contributor agreement + we need a payment email. We9ll handle that via a short onboarding form; privacy-friendly.

release-bot: Released: community-templates v0.3.1 by @elena 56 assets: changelog, patched CI workflow, eval example. https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-templates/releases/tag/v0.3.1

newsletter-bot: Reminder: If you want a short blurb in next week9s community newsletter, reply with 1-line highlight by EOD Fri.

elena: Please RT the release link and drop any showcase nominations. We9ll have a follow-up doc with meeting links and room assignments. :rocket:

jordan: Will the triage session be recorded? I9d like to share with maintainers who can9t make it.
elena: Yes, recording will be optional for each room; we9ll publish notes and a short highlight reel.

sam: Awesome. I9ll echo this to eng and community channels.

maya: One small ask 56 can we add a label "triage-night" to issues to track contributions from the event?
elena: Done. I just added the label and updated the issue templates to remind newcomers about the stipend.

elena: Thanks team. See you Wednesday! :seedling:
